items: Provides at least one database schema or table definition with column names and types
Defines at least one API endpoint with HTTP method, path, and request/response shape
Specifies data types or field constraints for key entities
Addresses indexing strategy or query optimization for critical access patterns
Includes error response definitions or HTTP error codes
Defines at least one data validation rule or input constraint
Specifies relationship constraints, foreign keys, or referential integrity if relational database
Addresses pagination, filtering, or sorting for list endpoints
Defines enum values, status codes, or state machine transitions used in the system
Includes at least one sequence diagram, processing flow, or step-by-step algorithm description
